title: DECISION: FIPS counter incremented inside write_lock
description: fips_provider_count is incremented/decremented inside the write_lock on the provider list (crypto2dev_registry.c). This prevents a reader from observing a new provider in the list while reading a stale FIPS count — TOCTOU between 'is FIPS active?' and 'which provider am I dispatching to?' would silently allow non-FIPS dispatch. A reviewer might suggest moving the atomic_read() outside the lock as an optimization; this would reintroduce the race. Do not move either the increment or the read out of the write/read lock pair.
